info.description:
Public REST API exposed by the KrewOps API Gateway. The gateway fronts the auth,
user, work, and search gRPC services, exposing them as a single JSON/REST surface
for mobile and web clients. All responses are wrapped in a consistent envelope
(see response.SuccessResponse / response.ErrorResponse).
info.title: KrewOps API Gateway

post.description: Sends a one-time password via SMS to the given phone number. Used to start login/signup.

parameters.description: Phone number to send the OTP to
parameters.name: request

429.description: Too many OTP requests for this phone number

post.description:
Verifies the OTP sent to the given phone number. On success returns an access/refresh token pair
and the authenticated user's profile completion state. Creates the user on first verification.
post.summary: Verify an OTP and log in

parameters.description: Phone number and OTP code to verify
parameters.name: request

put.description: Updates the worker's selected work types, skills, and rate preferences.
put.summary: Update the current user's worker profile selections

parameters.description: Updated work type/skill selections and rate preferences
parameters.name: request

post.description: Onboards the user as a worker and records their initial sector/segment selections.
post.summary: Create the current user's worker profile

parameters.description: Worker profile details and category/segment selections
